## Detect what others miss

### The ATCC Universal Mycoplasma Detection Kit detects over 120 species with high sensitivity,
### helping you protect the integrity of your cell cultures and ensure confidence in your results.

[Learn more][10]

## Physiologically relevant PBMCs

### Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) deliver consistent, assay-ready performance to model
### responses and generate reliable data.

[Learn more][11]

## Build better, more reliable molecular diagnostic assays

### Power your assays with quantitative genomic and synthetic nucleic acids designed for accuracy,
### confidence, and reproducibility.

[Explore now][12]

## More predictive research starts with advanced models

### Leverage human‑relevant organoid models to gain deeper insights into disease biology and
### therapeutic response.

[Explore organoids][13]

 

[ [Fluorescent blue and green spheres of leukemic cells.] ][14]

### Oncology and immuno-oncology

Discover advanced biological models and patient-derived cell lines that can help you transform the
cancer treatment landscape.

[Discover now][15]

Streamline your toxicological studies by incorporating credible models that support every phase of
your research and testing process.

[Streamline your studies][17]

Develop and validate your molecular diagnostic assays faster with relevant, ready-to-use reference
materials.

[Find assay development tools][19]

Combine the power of physical standards with authenticated whole-genome and whole-transcriptome
data.

### New Products

Through targeted acquisitions and our own internal research and development efforts, ATCC provides
the authenticated, cutting-edge products you need to make incredible discoveries.

[Explore new products][27]
[ [Scientists Working in The Laboratory iStock-1181391587.jpg] ][28]

### Coming Soon Products

Explore our coming soon products for a preview of what our team is developing for diagnostics
development, drug discovery, toxicology profiling, analytical testing, and more. 

[See what's coming next][29]

 

ATCC (American Type Culture Collection) is a nonprofit, global biological resource center and
standards organization and the leading developer and supplier of authenticated cells lines and
microorganisms. We leverage our rich history and knowledge to provide the products, services, and
resources scientists need to conduct critical life science research.

# Making the Medicines of Tomorrow

As a dedicated CDMO serving the healthcare industry, we bring life-enhancing and life-saving
treatments to market for our customers and their patients. We are a pioneer and world leader in the
CDMO industry, setting the pace with cutting-edge science, smart technology, and lean manufacturing.
United by a common purpose, we turn our customers’ breakthrough innovations into viable therapies
and manufacture the medicines of tomorrow.

Founded in Switzerland in 1897, our company is the first and original CDMO. Today, we bring together
a team of 20,000 colleagues across five continents to deliver integrated offerings that meet the
complex needs of our global customer community.

# Making the Medicines of Tomorrow

As a dedicated CDMO serving the healthcare industry, we bring life-enhancing and life-saving
treatments to market for our customers and their patients. We are a pioneer and world leader in the
CDMO industry, setting the pace with cutting-edge science, smart technology, and lean manufacturing.
United by a common purpose, we turn our customers’ breakthrough innovations into viable therapies
and manufacture the medicines of tomorrow.

Founded in Switzerland in 1897, our company is the first and original CDMO. Today, we bring together
a team of 20,000 colleagues across five continents to deliver integrated offerings that meet the
complex needs of our global customer community.

## A Trusted Partner of Life Science Research and the Biopharmaceutical Industry


We are living in the bio-century. Global medical knowledge is expanding at a rapid pace. But despite
huge breakthroughs, many diseases, such as cancer, rheumatism or Alzheimer's, are still not
curable.  Sartorius is part of the solution.

We help to ensure that new scientific discoveries can be translated more quickly into effective
patient care. With technologies, platforms and partnerships for a common goal: better health for
more people.

Products

## Explore Our Products
* [
  Primary Cells
  
  Primary cells are isolated from fresh tissues, which can maintain the basic properties of the
  original cells. Therefore, as an in vitro experimental model, primary cells are widely used in
  basic research of molecular, cell biology and biomedicine, such as proteomics, genomics and
  genetics, and also in drug screening, drug metabolism and toxicology, cancer drug research, etc.
  AcceGen provides 1,278 kinds of primary cells from human and animals, including human primary
  cells from motor system, nervous system, endocrine system, digestive system, blood system, urinary
  system, reproductive system, immune system, respiratory system, and PBMCs; and animal primary
  cells from mouse, rat, bovine, monkey, rabbit, porcine, chicken, dog, cat, and horse.
  
  Explore More
  ][167]
* [
  Tumor Cell Lines
  
  Tumor cell lines, also called Cancer cell lines, are an important part of tumors, they are the
  main component of tumors and tissue specific. Cancer cells have three important basic
  characteristics: immortality, migration, and loss of contact inhibition. In addition, carcinoma
  cells have many physiological, biochemical, and morphological characteristics that are different
  from normal cells. Different cancer cell lines provide a wide range of experimental materials for
  studying the occurrence and development of tumors and have played an important role in the
  in-depth study of tumor immunotherapy, tumor-targeted therapy, and tumor resistance.
  
  Explore More
  ][168]
* [
  Transfected Stable Cell Lines
  
  Transfected Stable Cell Lines is an important research tool for pharmaceutical drug discovery,
  compound screening, and gene therapy research. The transfected stable cell lines are constructed
  by integrating the exogenous plasmid DNA into the host cell chromosome so that the host cell can
  express the protein of interest for a long period of time. Key Features of AcceGen Transfected
  Stable Cell Lines: ● The exogenous fragment can be stably expressed in dividing cells for a long
  time (> 2 weeks). ● Establishing stable cell lines can help screen appropriate number of cells for
  experimental research. ● By establishing stable cell lines, the cost of excessive conversion of
  dyes or virus packaging can be greatly reduced, and experimental research is greatly facilitated.
  ● Establishing stable cell lines can achieve better genetic interference effects. ● It can
  effectively eliminate the interference of individual differences (the same type of cells,
  different individual cell genomes) on the experimental results. AcceGen is committed to providing
  ready-to-go stable cell lines and knockout cell lysate for your basic research. Use the Mutant
  Gene Nomenclature to search, if you cannot find the specific product in our database, AcceGen
  Custom Stable Cell Lines Service is committed to pave new ways to meet all your needs.
  
  Explore More
  ][169]
* [
  Immortalized Cell Lines
  
  After the primary cells experience limited population proliferation during the culture process,
  the primary cells cease to proliferate. Immortalized cells are derived from primary cells:
  exogenous immortalized genes (EBV, HPV E6 / 7 and SV40 T antigens of recombinant lentivirus,
  retrovirus & adenovirus, hTERT, p53) are introduced into target cells by gene transfection
  technology and immortalized cell lines are established to achieve cell culture in vitro so that
  cells cultured in vitro have the ability to proliferate and there is no difference between cells.
  Through immortalization, those cells that are difficult to pass down, slow to proliferate, and
  easy to age can be immortalized, thereby providing researchers with more cell resources and
  providing a good in vitro cell model for scientific research. AcceGen has about 60 kinds of
  immortalised cell lines, including human immortalised cells, mouse immortalised cells, and rat
  immortalised cells. AcceGen also provides Custom Cell Immortalization Service for your unique
  solutions.
  
  Explore More
  ][170]
* [
  Stem Cells
  
  Stem Cells, also calls Progenitor Cells, are a kind of self-replicating pluripotent cells, which
  can differentiate into multiple functional cells under certain conditions. Given this
  characteristic, some diseases can be cured by transplanting stem cells or related derivatives into
  patients to replace damaged cells. Stem cells have become the frontier and hotspot of life science
  and medical research at the beginning of this century because of the broad application prospects
  in the fields of disease treatment and regenerative medicine.
  
  Explore More
  ][171]
* [
  MicroRNA Agomir/Antagomir
  
  MicroRNA (miRNA) is a type of endogenous small RNA with a length of about 20-24 nucleotides. A
  combination of several miRNAs can be used to fine-tune the expression of a gene. MicroRNA Agomir
  is a special-labeled and chemically modified double-stranded small RNA that mimics the endogenous
  miRNA to regulate the biological function of the target gene. MicroRNA Antagomir is an especially
  chemically modified miRNA antagonist. It strongly competes with mature miRNAs in the body to
  prevent the complementary pairing of miRNAs and their target genes, thereby inhibiting miRNAs from
  functioning. NOMENCLATURE 1. The miRNA mature body is abbreviated as miR, and then according to
  its species name, such as the human being abbreviated as hsa, and the order in which it was found
  is represented by Arabic numerals, such as hsa-miR-122. 2. Highly homologous miRNAs are followed
  by lowercase letters (a, b, c, ...), such as hsa-miR-34a, hsa-miR-34b, hsa-miR-34c, and so on. 3.
  MiRNAs with the same mature sequence are transcribed and processed from DNA sequences on different
  chromosomes, followed by Arabic numerals to indicate the difference, such as hsa-mi

## Explore Our Products
* [
  Primary Cells
  
  Primary cells are isolated from fresh tissues, which can maintain the basic properties of the
  original cells. Therefore, as an in vitro experimental model, primary cells are widely used in
  basic research of molecular, cell biology and biomedicine, such as proteomics, genomics and
  genetics, and also in drug screening, drug metabolism and toxicology, cancer drug research, etc.
  AcceGen provides 1,278 kinds of primary cells from human and animals, including human primary
  cells from motor system, nervous system, endocrine system, digestive system, blood system, urinary
  system, reproductive system, immune system, respiratory system, and PBMCs; and animal primary
  cells from mouse, rat, bovine, monkey, rabbit, porcine, chicken, dog, cat, and horse.
  
  Explore More
  ][167]
* [
  Tumor Cell Lines
  
  Tumor cell lines, also called Cancer cell lines, are an important part of tumors, they are the
  main component of tumors and tissue specific. Cancer cells have three important basic
  characteristics: immortality, migration, and loss of contact inhibition. In addition, carcinoma
  cells have many physiological, biochemical, and morphological characteristics that are different
  from normal cells. Different cancer cell lines provide a wide range of experimental materials for
  studying the occurrence and development of tumors and have played an important role in the
  in-depth study of tumor immunotherapy, tumor-targeted therapy, and tumor resistance.
  
  Explore More
  ][168]
* [
  Transfected Stable Cell Lines
  
  Transfected Stable Cell Lines is an important research tool for pharmaceutical drug discovery,
  compound screening, and gene therapy research. The transfected stable cell lines are constructed
  by integrating the exogenous plasmid DNA into the host cell chromosome so that the host cell can
  express the protein of interest for a long period of time. Key Features of AcceGen Transfected
  Stable Cell Lines: ● The exogenous fragment can be stably expressed in dividing cells for a long
  time (> 2 weeks). ● Establishing stable cell lines can help screen appropriate number of cells for
  experimental research. ● By establishing stable cell lines, the cost of excessive conversion of
  dyes or virus packaging can be greatly reduced, and experimental research is greatly facilitated.
  ● Establishing stable cell lines can achieve better genetic interference effects. ● It can
  effectively eliminate the interference of individual differences (the same type of cells,
  different individual cell genomes) on the experimental results. AcceGen is committed to providing
  ready-to-go stable cell lines and knockout cell lysate for your basic research. Use the Mutant
  Gene Nomenclature to search, if you cannot find the specific product in our database, AcceGen
  Custom Stable Cell Lines Service is committed to pave new ways to meet all your needs.
  
  Explore More
  ][169]
* [
  Immortalized Cell Lines
  
  After the primary cells experience limited population proliferation during the culture process,
  the primary cells cease to proliferate. Immortalized cells are derived from primary cells:
  exogenous immortalized genes (EBV, HPV E6 / 7 and SV40 T antigens of recombinant lentivirus,
  retrovirus & adenovirus, hTERT, p53) are introduced into target cells by gene transfection
  technology and immortalized cell lines are established to achieve cell culture in vitro so that
  cells cultured in vitro have the ability to proliferate and there is no difference between cells.
  Through immortalization, those cells that are difficult to pass down, slow to proliferate, and
  easy to age can be immortalized, thereby providing researchers with more cell resources and
  providing a good in vitro cell model for scientific research. AcceGen has about 60 kinds of
  immortalised cell lines, including human immortalised cells, mouse immortalised cells, and rat
  immortalised cells. AcceGen also provides Custom Cell Immortalization Service for your unique
  solutions.
  
  Explore More
  ][170]
* [
  Stem Cells
  
  Stem Cells, also calls Progenitor Cells, are a kind of self-replicating pluripotent cells, which
  can differentiate into multiple functional cells under certain conditions. Given this
  characteristic, some diseases can be cured by transplanting stem cells or related derivatives into
  patients to replace damaged cells. Stem cells have become the frontier and hotspot of life science
  and medical research at the beginning of this century because of the broad application prospects
  in the fields of disease treatment and regenerative medicine.
  
  Explore More
  ][171]
* [
  MicroRNA Agomir/Antagomir
  
  MicroRNA (miRNA) is a type of endogenous small RNA with a length of about 20-24 nucleotides. A
  combination of several miRNAs can be used to fine-tune the expression of a gene. MicroRNA Agomir
  is a special-labeled and chemically modified double-stranded small RNA that mimics the endogenous
  miRNA to regulate the biological function of the target gene. MicroRNA Antagomir is an especially
  chemically modified miRNA antagonist. It strongly competes with mature miRNAs in the body to
  prevent the complementary pairing of miRNAs and their target genes, thereby inhibiting miRNAs from
  functioning. NOMENCLATURE 1. The miRNA mature body is abbreviated as miR, and then according to
  its species name, such as the human being abbreviated as hsa, and the order in which it was found
  is represented by Arabic numerals, such as hsa-miR-122. 2. Highly homologous miRNAs are followed
  by lowercase letters (a, b, c, ...), such as hsa-miR-34a, hsa-miR-34b, hsa-miR-34c, and so on. 3.

  chromosomes, followed by Arabic numerals to indicate the difference, such as hsa-mi

## In-House Bioactivity Validation — From Sequence to Functional Proof

Antibody bioactivity validation is the functional confirmation that your antibody binds its target
with specificity and triggers the intended biological response. AntibodyLLM's weblab runs all
validation in-house — no outsourcing, no delays, full traceability.

### ELISA & Binding Assays

Quantitative antigen-binding confirmation. Direct, indirect, sandwich, and competition ELISA formats
for specificity and titer determination. First-line screen for all antibody sequencing and
production projects.

### SPR Binding Kinetics

Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) for real-time, label-free measurement of association rate (ka),
dissociation rate (kd), and equilibrium dissociation constant (KD). Critical for affinity ranking
and lead selection.

in relevant cellular models. Essential for therapeutic antibody development and IVD antibody
qualification.

Every antibody we deliver comes with bioactivity data.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about AntibodyLLM's platform and services.

### What is AI antibody design and how does it work?

AI antibody design uses large language models (LLMs) trained on protein sequence and structure data
to generate, predict, and optimize antibody sequences in silico. AntibodyLLM's platform combines
AI-generated candidates with wet-lab expression and bioactivity validation in a closed-loop workflow
— dramatically reducing design cycles compared to traditional hybridoma or phage display methods.
The result: faster lead generation, lower cost, and higher hit rates.

### What is antibody sequencing and what success rate do you achieve?

Antibody sequencing recovers the precise variable region sequences (VH and VL) of an antibody from
hybridoma cells or purified protein. AntibodyLLM achieves a 99% antibody sequencing success rate
using NGS deep sequencing, LC-MS/MS, and Sanger methods matched to your sample type. We only deliver
sequences that have passed our internal verification — expression-confirmed and
bioactivity-validated in our weblab before the final report is handed over. No unverified sequences,
ever.

### What does recombinant protein expression involve?

Recombinant protein expression is the production of a target protein by introducing its gene into a
host cell system — typically CHO, HEK293, or E. coli — and inducing protein production at scale.
AntibodyLLM uses optimized CHO cell systems for both transient and stable antibody expression,
delivering >95% purity from mg-scale feasibility studies to gram-scale manufacturing. Our
proprietary CRISPR-integrated CHO cell lines ensure consistent, high-yield output batch to batch.

### How do you validate antibody bioactivity?

AntibodyLLM's in-house weblab performs full bioreactivity validation including ELISA for binding
specificity and titer, SPR (surface plasmon resonance) for real-time kinetics (ka, kd, KD), and
cell-based functional assays for receptor blocking, ADCC, and biological activity. All validation is
conducted in-house — no third-party outsourcing — ensuring faster turnaround, complete data
traceability, and a single point of accountability from sample to result.

### What is stable cell line development and why does it matter?

Stable cell line development creates a host cell (typically CHO) that permanently expresses your
antibody or protein of interest — essential for consistent, scalable biopharmaceutical
manufacturing. AntibodyLLM uses CRISPR site-specific integration and UCOE (Ubiquitous Chromatin
Opening Element) technology to eliminate random integration and gene silencing. The result is a
deterministic, high-yield CHO cell line with 95%+ project success rate and up to 3× improvement in
expression yield versus conventional stable cell line methods.

### Do you offer OEM antibody manufacturing?

Yes. AntibodyLLM offers white-label OEM antibody manufacturing for IVD companies, diagnostics
developers, and biotech firms. Our OEM/ODM service covers cell line development, scale-up
production, analytical characterization, bioactivity validation, and packaging under NDA. We support
mg to kg quantities with full quality documentation and regulatory support. Contact us to discuss
your OEM antibody manufacturing requirements.

From AI antibody design to sequence-verified delivery and bioactivity validation — one team, one
platform, zero outsourcing.

specificity and titer, SPR (surface plasmon resonance) for real-time kinetics (ka, kd, KD), and
cell-based functional assays for receptor blocking, ADCC, and biological activity. All validation is
conducted in-house — no third-party outsourcing — ensuring faster turnaround, complete data
traceability, and a single point of accountability from sample to result.

### What is stable cell line development and why does it matter?

Stable cell line development creates a host cell (typically CHO) that permanently expresses your
antibody or protein of interest — essential for consistent, scalable biopharmaceutical
manufacturing. AntibodyLLM uses CRISPR site-specific integration and UCOE (Ubiquitous Chromatin
Opening Element) technology to eliminate random integration and gene silencing. The result is a
deterministic, high-yield CHO cell line with 95%+ project success rate and up to 3× improvement in
expression yield versus conventional stable cell line methods.

### Do you offer OEM antibody manufacturing?

Yes. AntibodyLLM offers white-label OEM antibody manufacturing for IVD companies, diagnostics
developers, and biotech firms. Our OEM/ODM service covers cell line development, scale-up
production, analytical characterization, bioactivity validation, and packaging under NDA. We support
mg to kg quantities with full quality documentation and regulatory support. Contact us to discuss
your OEM antibody manufacturing requirements.

## Build your next antibody with us

From AI antibody design to sequence-verified delivery and bioactivity validation — one team, one
platform, zero outsourcing.

# BUILT FOR COMMERCIAL

engineered for scale

Commercial biologics manufacturing demands infrastructure, regulatory discipline, and operational
precision. Bora Biologics offers a bi‑coastal, inspection‑proven U.S. biologics platform designed
for commercialization from day one. Our integrated drug substance operations in San Diego, CA and
Rockville, MD, supported by a development center of excellence in Zhubei, Taiwan, provide the
foundation for reliable scale and licensed supply.

Together, our platform supports partners from development through commercial production — delivering
the execution discipline required for durable commercial performance.

 **20,000L **U.S. single-use bioreactor capacity
 **3 **active commercial programs supplying **6 ** global markets
  **200+ **GMP batches executed
**100% ** first-pass PPQ success
**2 ** FDA-registered facilities specialized in late-stage production
**1 ** integrated early-stage development center of excellence

[ EXPLORE how we do it ][43]

# Advancing Biologics

one cell at a time

A technology-driven Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), Bora Biologics
specializes in mammalian and microbial development and manufacturing. Our mission is to accelerate
access to cutting-edge technologies and comprehensive manufacturing capabilities that empower our
clients to transform the future of medicine. **With a focus on collaboration, we are dedicated to
advancing biologics one cell at a time.**

# End-to-End CDMO Solutions

tailored to you

We adapt seamlessly to your needs, ensuring efficiency and cost savings at every stage of
development and manufacturing. **Your success is our priority.**

mammalian & microbial expertise

multidisciplinary approach and a focus on innovation, our team delivers customized solutions that
drive efficiency, quality, and accelerated time-to-market for biologics offerings.
* Cell line development
* High throughput media screening and optimization
* Mammalian cell culture development
* Microbial fermentation development
* High throughput resin screening and chromatography development
* Filtration process development (depth, sterile, viral, TFF)
* Inclusion body recovery and protein refold
* Conjugation and pegylation process optimization
* Technology transfer and scale up
* Viral clearance study design and support
* Process characterization

# BUILT FOR COMMERCIAL

engineered for scale

Commercial biologics manufacturing demands infrastructure, regulatory discipline, and operational
precision. Bora Biologics offers a bi‑coastal, inspection‑proven U.S. biologics platform designed
for commercialization from day one. Our integrated drug substance operations in San Diego, CA and
Rockville, MD, supported by a development center of excellence in Zhubei, Taiwan, provide the
foundation for reliable scale and licensed supply.

Together, our platform supports partners from development through commercial production — delivering
the execution discipline required for durable commercial performance.

  **200+ **GMP batches executed
**100% ** first-pass PPQ success

**1 ** integrated early-stage development center of excellence

clients to transform the future of medicine. **With a focus on collaboration, we are dedicated to
advancing biologics one cell at a time.**

selflessness, dedication, hope, resilience and respect for self and others.

CLD is making a real difference in the lives of minority youth. Because of CLD’s strong focus and
emphasis on hard work and high achievement, 77 percent of CLD participants report enrolling in some
institution of post-secondary learning. Moreover, 46 percent of CLD participants who attend college
earn a college degree. By comparison, only 25 percent of Indiana’s African American college students
in publicly supported institutions earn a bachelor’s degree in six years. This level of impact on
youth affirms the success and need for CLD’s mission and programs.

CLD offers more than twenty quality Indianapolis Youth Development programs for middle and high
school students and their parents/supportive adults that prepare youth for success in school and in
life. All CLD experiences are based on the core values of *character, education, leadership,
service, *and* career. *

### Advancing Immunotherapy
### and Engineered Cell Innovation

CLG applies its expertise in stability testing, authentication, sterility analysis, and custom
genetic studies to cancer immunotherapy and engineered cell programs—while continuing to support
cell therapy and regenerative medicine research. We deliver the foundational data research teams
rely on to advance programs, reduce translational risk, and improve translational outcomes.
[ Cancer Research Hub ][62]

### Clients We Are  Proud To Serve.

Optimized solutions tailored for every segment of the industry.

#### Small Biotech Companies
* Save money and time with our competitive pricing and TAT.
* Begin processing immediately per existing SOPs.
* Fast and smooth process.

#### Large Pharma/Biotech Companies

* Trusted Reliability and delivery.
* We accelerate the process, instead of slowing it down.

* We can work seamlessly through procurement groups.

#### Universities & Academic Research Organizations
* Satisfy your grant requirements
* Ensure completely accurate results.
* Save time and money with our TAT and competitive pricing.
* Our trusted reputation gives you peace of mind.

[ Get a Quote ][63]

### Genetic Stability and Integrity
### as Translational Requirements

Cell therapy, immunotherapy, and regenerative medicine programs depend on genetically stable,
authenticated, and contamination-free cell systems. CLG delivers genomic stability testing,
authentication, sterility analysis, and custom genetic services to validate cell integrity
throughout research and translational development.

Our services support:
* Stability assessment across passages and expansion
* Authentication of established and engineered cell lines
* Sterility testing to detect mycoplasma and contamination risks
* Custom cytogenetic and molecular studies tailored to complex platforms

Array Comparative Genomic Hybridization

aCGH technology for human stem cell and cancer cell lines with probe coverage in ISCA and cancer
associated genes.

G-Band Karyotyping
Chromosome analysis of stem cell lines, cancer lines, and other cell lines from over 15 species.
PCR Based Mycoplasma Detection

Detection of over 200 different strains of mycoplasma bacteria found in cultured cells.

Short Tandem Repeat Analysis

Human cell line identity, authentication, and cross-contamination detection.

Fluorescence in Situ Hybridization

Early detection of abnormal emerging cell populations and cryptic chromosome aberrations by
interphase FISH.

Custom Assay Development

Cell Line Genetics conducts custom projects such as 100-cell chromosome analysis, transgene site
mapping, validation of aCGH findings, and much more.

### Expert Analysis Services

At Cell Line Genetics, we follow the highest industry standards (ANSI/ATCC ASN-0002-2021) to provide
two levels of STR Profile Analysis.
[ Basic ][64]

#### STR Profiling 100
* Ideal for routine database cross-referencing, profile comparisons, and contamination checks.
* Easy to read STR profile report which includes a sample allele table. Electropherograms are also
  available by request.
* 24/7 access to reports via our secure cloud database at no extra cost.

[ Learn More ][65]
[ Comprehensive ][66]

#### STR Profiling 300
* Perfect for authenticating new cell lines and establishing their unique identity.
* Includes analysis against the Swiss Institute of Bioinformatics’ Cellosaurus and Cell Line
  Genetics databases.
* Ensures thorough cross-referencing and enhanced discrimination of cell lines.

[ Learn More ][67]

A simple, secure, and transparent workflow designed to get your results fast.

Sign up for your CLG online account to get started.

##### Submit & Ship Samples

Complete our form with details about your sample and billing information. Then, ship your samples to
our lab.

##### View Your Reports

### Advancing Immunotherapy
### and Engineered Cell Innovation

CLG applies its expertise in stability testing, authentication, sterility analysis, and custom
genetic studies to cancer immunotherapy and engineered cell programs—while continuing to support
cell therapy and regenerative medicine research. We deliver the foundational data research teams
rely on to advance programs, reduce translational risk, and improve translational outcomes.
[ Cancer Research Hub ][62]

### Clients We Are  Proud To Serve.

Optimized solutions tailored for every segment of the industry.

#### Small Biotech Companies
* Save money and time with our competitive pricing and TAT.
* Begin processing immediately per existing SOPs.
* Fast and smooth process.

* We can work seamlessly through procurement groups.

#### Universities & Academic Research Organizations
* Satisfy your grant requirements
* Ensure completely accurate results.
* Save time and money with our TAT and competitive pricing.
* Our trusted reputation gives you peace of mind.

[ Get a Quote ][63]

### Genetic Stability and Integrity
### as Translational Requirements

Cell therapy, immunotherapy, and regenerative medicine programs depend on genetically stable,
authenticated, and contamination-free cell systems. CLG delivers genomic stability testing,
authentication, sterility analysis, and custom genetic services to validate cell integrity
throughout research and translational development.

Our services support:
* Stability assessment across passages and expansion
* Authentication of established and engineered cell lines
* Sterility testing to detect mycoplasma and contamination risks
* Custom cytogenetic and molecular studies tailored to complex platforms

Array Comparative Genomic Hybridization

aCGH technology for human stem cell and cancer cell lines with probe coverage in ISCA and cancer
associated genes.

G-Band Karyotyping
Chromosome analysis of stem cell lines, cancer lines, and other cell lines from over 15 species.
PCR Based Mycoplasma Detection

Detection of over 200 different strains of mycoplasma bacteria found in cultured cells.

Short Tandem Repeat Analysis

Human cell line identity, authentication, and cross-contamination detection.

Fluorescence in Situ Hybridization

Early detection of abnormal emerging cell populations and cryptic chromosome aberrations by
interphase FISH.

Custom Assay Development

Cell Line Genetics conducts custom projects such as 100-cell chromosome analysis, transgene site
mapping, validation of aCGH findings, and much more.

### Expert Analysis Services

At Cell Line Genetics, we follow the highest industry standards (ANSI/ATCC ASN-0002-2021) to provide
two levels of STR Profile Analysis.
[ Basic ][64]

#### STR Profiling 100
* Ideal for routine database cross-referencing, profile comparisons, and contamination checks.
* Easy to read STR profile report which includes a sample allele table. Electropherograms are also
  available by request.
* 24/7 access to reports via our secure cloud database at no extra cost.

[ Learn More ][65]
[ Comprehensive ][66]

#### STR Profiling 300
* Perfect for authenticating new cell lines and establishing their unique identity.
* Includes analysis against the Swiss Institute of Bioinformatics’ Cellosaurus and Cell Line
  Genetics databases.
* Ensures thorough cross-referencing and enhanced discrimination of cell lines.

[ Learn More ][67]

### How Our Process Works

A simple, secure, and transparent workflow designed to get your results fast.

##### Create Your CLG Account

Sign up for your CLG online account to get started.

##### Submit & Ship Samples

Complete our form with details about your sample and billing information. Then, ship your samples to
our lab.

##### View Your Reports

Login to CLG’s StemCloud — our secure delivery system to view your reports.

#### Introducing StemCloud™

Cell Line Genetics’s private and secure report delivery system developed in collaboration with
Citrix’s ShareFile Cloud Storage.

Our lab has relied on Cell Line Genetics for stem cell characterization, authentication and
customization services for over 3 years. CLG has consistently provided the level of service,
expertise and turnaround our research efforts demand.

Fred H. Gage, Ph.D. — The Salk Institute for Biological Studies

### [Pipette Tips][177]

#### Pipette Tips

Cotaus automation pipette tip series products are suitable for Tecan, Hamilton, Agilent, Beckman,
Qiagen, Dynex, Xantus, Apricot Designs, Roche and other high throughput automatic pipetting
workstations, automatic sampling systems, mainly used for liquid distribution and transfer, to
achieve high throughput operation of biological samples. Lot-tested during production on actual
brand workstations for which they are used, automation tips are well adaptive with a good match.

Cotaus universal pipette tips are made to work with a wide range of mechanical and electronic single
and multichannel pipettors, including brands like Dalong, Gilson, Eppendorf, ThermoFisher,RAININ,
Brand, Sartorius, and others.

Additionally, we offer customized pipette tips tailored to your unique experimental needs. By using
state-of-the-art production facilities and automated manufacturing processes, we guarantee efficient
mass production while ensuring product consistency and stability, which enhances efficiency and
minimizes operational risks.

**Cotaus Pipette Tip Features：**

◉ Made of high quality polypropylene(PP)
◉ Sterile or non-sterile
◉ Filtered or non-filtered
◉ Autoclavable and chemically stable
◉ DNase/RNase free, Pyrogen free, Bioburden free, PCR inhibitor free, or endotoxin free
◉ Low CV accuracy, strong hydrophobicity, no liquid adhesion

### [Nucleic Acid][178]

#### Nucleic Acid

# The Gene to Antibody Company ^{™}

## Innovative Technologies Enable Antibody Discovery Success

Genovac offers a unique combination of advanced antibody discovery and development tools. Our
innovative immunization technologies, multiple species options, and single B cell screening
platforms position us to deliver success against a wide range of targets, including challenging
multi-transmembrane proteins. We serve to be a one-stop shop for our clients, offering biologics
production and a full suite of characterization services.

[ Discovery Technologies ][22]
[ ][23]

## Opening new worlds for Biotech and Pharma

Our pioneering science, trusted proprietary technologies and commitment to continuous improvement
has made us leaders in the discovery of antibodies against challenging targets such as ion channels
and GPCRs. We’re proud to join our clients’ pursuit of the most innovative solutions to the
challenge of developing therapeutic and diagnostic products.

[ The Genovac Way ][24]
>3.6k We have completed over 3,600 antibody discovery projects. We pride ourselves on delivering
hits where our competitors fail.
[ ][25]

## WE DELIVER MORE HITS IN THE SHORTEST POSSIBLE TIME

Our technologies dramatically increase the speed, robustness and precision with which we discover
and produce new antibodies. We’re committed to delivering high value antibodies against the most
difficult targets to enable our clients’ programs and reduce development timelines.

*** Watch our latest webinar, in collaboration with Carterra and ENPICOM:**
Discovery, Characterization, and Generative Deep Learning-Based Humanization of Therapeutic Antibody
Candidates*

[ ACCESS WEBINAR ][26]
25 Genovac has 25 years of experience in antibody discovery. Working with us brings a wealth of
know-how to your team.

HOW CAN GENOVAC HELP?

## What Clients Say About Our CRDMO Concept

A flexible research driven organization that delivers on promise.
Eugeen VanmechelenCSO and Founder, ADx NeuroSciences
[Eugeen Vanmechelen][Eugeen Vanmechelen]
After several failed attempts with other vendors, we turned to Icosagen to tackle the expression and
purification of a particularly complex target protein. While previous providers struggled with the
technical intricacies of our project, Icosagen demonstrated exceptional expertise by developing a
robust, optimized protocol where others couldn't. Icosagen's team succeeded in delivering
high-purity and biologically active protein that met our exact specifications, effectively saving
our research from significant delays. We are incredibly impressed with their technical persistence
and commitment to quality.
Emil Ruvinov, PhDDepartment Manager, Protein-Technology-Discovery Biotherapeutics, Ferring
Therapeutics
[This is a picture of Ruvinov Emil.][This is a picture of Ruvinov Emil.]
At Advesya, we had the opportunity to collaborate with Icosagen on the generation, development, and
testing of an antibody for our ADC program. From the outset, the collaboration was smooth,
professional, and productive. Icosagen delivered high-quality results both in small- and large-scale
antibody production, all within the agreed timelines and budget. Their technical expertise,
transparent communication, and flexibility were key factors in the successful advancement of our
project. We value this partnership and look forward to potential future collaborations.
Stephane LameynardieHead of PMO, Director Technical Operations & Alliance, Advesya
[This is a picture of Stephane Lameynardie.][This is a picture of Stephane Lameynardie.]
An excellent CRO for protein production and purification.
Ilgar Mamedov Head of Lead generation team, Egle Therapeutics
[Ilgar Mamedov][Ilgar Mamedov]
A reliable partner with a strong emphasis on professionalism, client-centric problem-solving, and
scientific excellence.
Ward CelusScientific Operations Manager, Montis Biosciences
[Ward Celus][Ward Celus]
A reliable and custom-friendly biotech service provider.
Paolo MichieliFounder and CEO, Klasther Biopharma
[Paolo Michieli][Paolo Michieli]
A very flexible CRO for protein/antibody based projects.
Jaime GuillénSenior Research Scientist, ImCheck Therapeutics
[Jaime Guillén][Jaime Guillén]
IOME Bio worked with Icosagen over several years on more than 10 projects, focusing on pre-clinical
antibody/protein production and characterization programs during our lead discovery, selection and
optimization phases. Icosagen stood out for its services; consistently delivered high-quality
proteins, demonstrated reliability, always maintained quick turnaround times, and provided open and
transparent communication. Their professional project management and reporting distinguished their
services. We felt treated at eye level and regarded Icosagen as an essential extension of our team,
which helped to propel our research goals forward. We look forward to continuing our partnership
with Icosagen.
Japar ShamshievCSO, IOME Bio
[ Japar Shamshiev][ Japar Shamshiev]
Fast responses, great flexibility, transparency, collaborative spirit, high quality.
Ridgeline Discovery
[Ridgeline Discovery][Ridgeline Discovery]
Top expertise!
Jean-Marc HerbertFounder and CEO, Abcely
[Jean-Marc Herbert][Jean-Marc Herbert]
As CEO of Lys Therapeutics, I can confidently state that our collaboration with Icosagen has been
crucial for our projects. Their exceptional expertise in biochemical and molecular biology has not
only advanced our research but has also provided unparalleled scientific support across all our
initiatives. Icosagen’s dedicated team consistently delivered innovative solutions, meticulous
analyses, and valuable insights that have significantly accelerated our progress. Their commitment
to excellence and their proactive approach in addressing challenges have made them an indispensable
partner in our journey toward scientific breakthroughs for our lead drug LYS241.
Manuel BlancCo-founder and CEO of Lys Therapeutics
[Manuel Blanc][Manuel Blanc]
The pro-activeness of the team as well as the flexibility is key to provide the good service we have
experienced with our proteins which are beyond the typical antibody.
Orionis Biosciences
[Orionis Biosciences][Orionis Biosciences]
Very personal attention, great quality.
Biomunex Pharamceuticals
[Biomunex Pharamceuticals][Biomunex Pharamceuticals]
Easy contacting and fast service order.
Orion Pharma
[Orion Pharma][Orion Pharma]
Speed, professional attitude.
University of Helsinki
[University of Helsinki][University of Helsinki]
Transfected cell samples are kept for to allow checking of transgene sequences in case there is
unexpected results with protein production analytical results. Icosagen team is also scientifically
sound in their advice and flexible if some additional analytics are required.
Lys Therapeutics
[Lys Therapeutics][Lys Therapeutics]
High success-rate, easy to communicate with.
Olink
[Olink][Olink]
I placed my first work order at Icosagen over a decade ago. Since then Icosagen has conducted close
to 20 projects for us as regular provider of purified antibodies in variable production scales,
dependent on the projects’ needs. We enjoy the large and ready-to-use toolbox offering a broad
choice of constant domains of different species and Fc domains with different effector functions.
Provided VH/VL domains are cloned into prepared expression vectors to produce the molecule of choice
in a plug-and-play mode. The QMCF technology platform is robust, even in challenging cases Icosagen
manages to deliver the agreed amounts of material in time. The material comes with data and reports,
all of high quality. Cost structures are transparent, and the price-performance ratio is optimal.
Icosagen cultivates a friendly, supportive, and problem-solving attitude, enabling their customers
to consistently relax and rely.
Head of Antibody Discovery, European biotech

# with iPSC Solutions & Primary Cell Models

Offering iPSCs, primary cells, genome editing, and characterization, we deliver trusted solutions
that drive discovery in drug development and disease modeling.

initiative enables the development of personalized, multi-organ toxicity profiles—supporting safer,
more precise oncology research.

## Minaris Advanced Testing

Standalone or integrated GMP testing across all biologics modalities, performed in our dedicated
140,000 ft² Philadelphia facility. With over 40 years of experience, we support cell therapies,
viral vectors, monoclonal antibodies, recombinant proteins, and vaccines with rapid,
regulator-accepted results.

Need standalone or integrated testing?

[ Explore Testing Services ][81]
* Analytical Development
  
  Our analytical scientists design, optimize and validate assays across the full lifecycle, from
  early-phase methods to commercial readiness. Services include potency, purity, identity and
  stability testing, aligned with ICH Q2 and global regulatory expectations. Integrated with
  development and manufacturing, we ensure reliable GMP performance across all modalities.
  
  [ Learn About Analytical Development ][82]
  1 / 8
* Assay Transfer
  
  Smooth assay transfer ensures continuity and reliability across sites and studies, maintaining
  consistency and accuracy. We deliver structured, data-driven transfers, including gap analysis,
  bridging studies and qualification/validation, in accordance with ICH Q2. Methods are supported
  across viral vectors, gene-edited cells, monoclonal antibodies (mAbs), proteins and vaccines,
  ensuring seamless readiness for lot release, stability and comparability studies.
  
  [ See Assay Transfer Support ][83]
  2 / 8
* Biosafety Testing
  
  With more than 40 years of biosafety expertise, Minaris provides GMP-compliant sterility,
  mycoplasma, endotoxin, adventitious agent and replication-competent virus testing. Our specialized
  focus on CGT ensures risk-based strategies tailored to viral vectors, plasmids and packaging
  systems. Results are audit-ready and regulator-accepted, supporting IND, IMPD and BLA submissions
  worldwide.
  
  [ Explore Biosafety Testing ][84]
  3 / 8
* Cell Line Characterization
  
  We provide comprehensive, regulatory-compliant characterization of Master, Working and
  End-of-Production Cell Banks, including sterility, mycoplasma, endotoxin, retroviral and identity
  testing. Our services align with the guidelines of the ICH, FDA, EMA and PMDA, enabling the faster
  release of GMP cell banks and seamless integration into development and manufacturing workflows.
  
  [ Learn About Cell Line Characterization ][85]
  4 / 8
* Lot Release
  
  A reliable lot release ensures that therapies reach patients without delay. Minaris provides a
  comprehensive GMP testing panel across various modalities, including sterility, identity, potency,
  purity, residuals, RCL/rcAAV and more. With thousands of batches tested, our validated assays
  support global submissions and commercial approvals, minimizing risk and accelerating patient
  access.
  
  [ See Lot Release ][86]
  5 / 8
* Potency
  
  Potency is a critical quality attribute. We design and validate custom assays, ranging from
  cell-based functional studies and reporter gene assays to ELISA, PCR and transduction efficiency
  tests. All assays meet ICH Q2 standards, providing meaningful biological insights that satisfy
  regulators and support product release and lifecycle management.
  
  [ Explore Potency ][87]
  6 / 8
* Stability
  
  We deliver ICH Q1-compliant stability programs, including long-term, real-time, accelerated and
  ongoing studies. Our methods support all biologic and advanced therapy modalities, with
  submission-ready data for global regulators. By evaluating shelf life and storage conditions, we
  ensure that therapies maintain their safety, quality and efficacy throughout distribution and
  patient use.
  
  [ Learn About Stability ][88]
  7 / 8

  clearance studies aligned with ICH Q5A(R2), FDA, EMA and WHO guidelines. Dedicated viral clearance
  suites with AKTA systems ensure rigorous validation across vectors, proteins and vaccines,
  safeguarding patient safety and accelerating regulatory approvals.

About Us

Found in 2009,Wuxi NEST Biotechnology is a worldwide manufacturer of plastic laboratory products.
State-of-the-art manufacturing equipment is used on an expansive manufacturing site based in Wuxi,
China. Decades of plastic-injection molding experience allows us to maintain the highest quality and
performance standards expected by the hospitals, research institutions and indusrial/clinical
laboraories that we serve, NEST is your best choice for laboratory consumables. NEST has launched
over 200 plastic consumable products for cell culture, molecular bislogy, immunoassays, liquid
handling and storage. With stricty controlled ISO 8 grade clean rooms, exacting manufacturing
standards and rigid QA procedures, the NEST brand enjoys an excellent reputation nationwide and
abroad. NEST products have been exported to North America, Europe, Japan, Korea, India and other
countries. NEST is committed to innovation. We continue to research and develop new platic
consumables suitable for life sciences research so that we can provide more cost-effective solutions
and cutting-edge laboratory consumables for our end-users. NEST has continually positioned itself as
a brand for high end laboratory consumables. NEST boasts of a high power laminar flow clean room
meeting the ISO 8 grade with a floor space of 2,000 square meters. These facilities are equipped
with a central feeding system, high precision injection machinery from Japan, robot arms with
automatic conveyers, hot runner molds, and vacuum plasma and corona treatment machines from Belgium,
Germany and USA. Inner room moisture content and temperature are adjustable. In 2013, NEST installed
a Rhodotron TT 200 from Belgium IBA, a world leader in the E-Beam sterilization industry. NEST
completes a full process chain from the sourcing of the raw materials to the in-house sterilization
of the final products ready for delivery to clients. NEST`s manufacturing site has been certified
with an ISO 9001:2008 management system. Our sterilization procedures meet the ISO 11137:2006 and
ISO 13485 standards.

lead organizations. 

Regional leads will design and host a weeklong, all‑expenses‑paid summer program that introduces
first‑ and second‑year college students to careers in biopharmaceutical manufacturing. Each site
will deliver an immersive experience featuring hands‑on training, mentorship, facility tours, and
direct engagement with industry professionals, helping to strengthen the future biopharma
workforce.

Tier 2) or at NIIMBL’s Headquarters (NIIMBL HQ) in Delaware to support NIIMBL-led projects.

## Who we are

Our members are stakeholders from across the biopharmaceutical manufacturing ecosystem, including
large and small companies, academic institutions, and nonprofits.

Members have the opportunity to collectively revolutionize current biomanufacturing platforms,
processes, and educational programs and share in the benefits of these transformative solutions.

[
Learn more about us ][102]
[Members talking at a NIIMBL event]


## Why NIIMBL

The NIIMBL ecosystem’s collaborative efforts to accelerate innovative manufacturing technologies
help to:
* Ensure a secure, integrated domestic supply chain
* Enable lifesaving and life-enhancing therapies to reach patients more quickly
* Strengthen biodefense
* Cement the United States’ leadership in the global manufacturing industry
* Increase the biopharmaceutical industry’s global competitiveness

## About biopharmaceuticals and biomanufacturing

## About biopharmaceuticals and biomanufacturing

Biopharmaceuticals are medicines and medical countermeasures that save, sustain, and improve lives.
They:
* are manufactured in, extracted from, or derived from biological sources and require complex
  manufacturing process.
* treat and prevent some of the most prevalent and debilitating diseases affecting human health,
  including cancer, diabetes, autoimmune disorders, and bacterial and viral infections, making
  biopharma one of the most valuable and important business sectors in the United States.
* play a crucial role in protecting the United States from health threats.

#### 2027 NIIMBL eXperience Regional RFA

**This opportunity has closed.**

NIIMBL is pleased to announce that applications are now open for 2027 NIIMBL eXperience regional
lead organizations. 

Regional leads will design and host a weeklong, all‑expenses‑paid summer program that introduces
first‑ and second‑year college students to careers in biopharmaceutical manufacturing. Each site
will deliver an immersive experience featuring hands‑on training, mentorship, facility tours, and
direct engagement with industry professionals, helping to strengthen the future biopharma
workforce. 

[**Learn more**][96]

#### RFA: Faculty Fellows

NIIMBL is pleased to announce the pilot of a faculty sabbatical in industry program. The NIIMBL
Faculty Fellows program provides financial support for faculty or instructional staff at
universities and community colleges to pursue a sabbatical either at an industry member (Tier 1 or
Tier 2) or at NIIMBL’s Headquarters (NIIMBL HQ) in Delaware to support NIIMBL-led projects.

**[Learn more][97]**

## Who we are

Our members are stakeholders from across the biopharmaceutical manufacturing ecosystem, including
large and small companies, academic institutions, and nonprofits.

Members have the opportunity to collectively revolutionize current biomanufacturing platforms,
processes, and educational programs and share in the benefits of these transformative solutions.

[
Learn more about us ][102]
[Members talking at a NIIMBL event]


## Why NIIMBL

The NIIMBL ecosystem’s collaborative efforts to accelerate innovative manufacturing technologies
help to:
* Ensure a secure, integrated domestic supply chain
* Enable lifesaving and life-enhancing therapies to reach patients more quickly
* Strengthen biodefense
* Cement the United States’ leadership in the global manufacturing industry
* Increase the biopharmaceutical industry’s global competitiveness

## About biopharmaceuticals and biomanufacturing

## About biopharmaceuticals and biomanufacturing

Biopharmaceuticals are medicines and medical countermeasures that save, sustain, and improve lives.
They:
* are manufactured in, extracted from, or derived from biological sources and require complex
  manufacturing process.
* treat and prevent some of the most prevalent and debilitating diseases affecting human health,
  including cancer, diabetes, autoimmune disorders, and bacterial and viral infections, making
  biopharma one of the most valuable and important business sectors in the United States.
* play a crucial role in protecting the United States from health threats.

# Welcome to a CDMO where science meets service excellence, where innovation merges with reliability

### Revolutionise your clinical development with our expert development & manufacturing services for

MONOCLONAL ANTIBODIES

NANODRUGS

## **We support your project from R&D to in-market supply**
## Start your CMC journey confidently with our tailored development and GMP manufacturing services

#### R&D services

Custom production services with all prominent expression systems providing recombinant proteins for
your R&D studies.

#### Process Development

Developing top-tier manufacturing processes for a range of molecules: proteins, antibodies,
bioconjugates, and nanodrugs.

#### Analytical Development

Phase-appropriate method development for mammalian, microbial, and bioconjugate manufacturing.

#### GMP Manufacturing

Our top-notch GMP facilities manufacture preclinical, clinical, and small commercial batches of
innovative therapies.

#### Fill & Finish

Our in-house aseptic filling supports liquid drug product manufacturing, accelerating your path to
clinic and market.

#### Project Management

From start to finish, our expert team of scientists guides you seamlessly through every step of your
CMC journey.

a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. ## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Remaker AI?

+

Remaker AI is an AI-powered creative platform with AI image editing as its core feature. It provides
powerful image processing tools that allow users to easily perform photo restoration, background
removal, style transfer, image upscaling, and more. Additionally, Remaker AI includes AI video
generation and a rich library of trending entertainment templates, helping users quickly create
viral short videos, Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts. Whether for individual creators or
enterprise teams, Remaker AI significantly boosts creative efficiency and delivers
professional-grade results.

### How does Remaker AI help improve content creation efficiency?

+

Remaker AI offers a full suite of intelligent tools that can automatically generate and process
images or videos based on simple user inputs. This dramatically saves time while significantly
improving content quality, making it suitable for all industries and creative scenarios.

### Do I need technical knowledge to use Remaker AI?

+

No technical knowledge is required. Remaker AI features a clean and intuitive interface that anyone
can pick up instantly. Every tool page also includes detailed step-by-step tutorials to help users
get started quickly.

### Does Remaker AI support multilingual content generation?

+

Yes. Remaker AI supports content generation in multiple languages including English, Chinese,
Japanese, German, and many others, allowing users worldwide to create high-quality assets in their
preferred language.

### How much does Remaker AI cost?

+

Remaker AI offers flexible credit-based plans ranging from $5.99 for 200 credits to $299 for 20,000
credits. Users can choose the package that best fits their needs. Many basic features are also
available for free.

### Does Remaker AI offer free credits or a free trial?

+

Yes. New users receive free credits upon sign-up, which can be used to generate and export
watermark-free images and videos. Additional credits and advanced features can be unlocked by
upgrading to VIP.

### Can I cancel my Remaker AI subscription at any time?

+

Remaker AI uses a one-time credit purchase model with no recurring monthly fees, so there is no
subscription to cancel.

### Can I use Remaker AI on both PC and mobile devices?

+

Yes. Remaker AI works seamlessly on Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android devices. Log in with the same
account and edit or enhance your photos and videos anytime, anywhere.

### Is payment on Remaker AI secure?

+

Yes. All payments are securely processed by Stripe. Remaker AI does not store your card information.
Stripe uses bank-level encryption and security standards to keep your payment information safe.

## Product highlights

### **Safe. Gentle. Precise. **

The new Safety-Multifly^{®} PRO combines maximum user safety with a high level of patient comfort.
The semi-automatic safety mechanism activates the needle in the vein, reducing the risk of needle
stick injuries and blood splatter after blood collection, while the ultra-thin-walled needle
supports a high level of patient comfort thanks to reduced insertion force and gentle blood flow.

[
Experience more
][158]
01 / 23

## Business areas

To meet your requirements in medicine and research, we offer a broad product portfolio in the fields
of pre-analysis, life science, laboratory automation and sample transport. The needs of the user are
always at the centre of our solutions.

[ICN Life-Science 1024x1024]

### Life Science

In the areas of liquid handling, cell culture, molecular biology, sample handling and microbiology,
we offer customised solutions of the highest purity and consistent quality. These are specially
designed to ensure reproducibility in analysis. Our products are certified and fulfil the strictest
requirements for research.

[
Life Science
][159]
[ICN Praaeanalytik 1024x1024]

### Preanalytics

For clinics, medical practices and laboratories, we offer a comprehensive range of sample collection
systems and accessories for blood, urine, faeces and saliva. We attach great importance to safety
and efficiency.

[
Preanalytics
][160]
[ICN Probentransport 1024x1024]

### Sample transport

As an essential part of the pre-analytical workflow, our sample transport products ensure the safety
and integrity of your diagnostic samples. We understand the need to safely ship potentially
infectious samples in accordance with clear ADR/RID and IATA dangerous goods regulations to ensure
the protection of all parties involved and to achieve optimal analytical results.

[
Sample transport
][161]
[ICN Labor-Automation 1024x1024]

### Laboratory automation

With our automation solutions, we make laboratory processes in pre-analytics faster, more precise
and more economical. Our many years of experience as a partner in laboratory automation make us a
reliable partner for your needs.

[
Laboratory automation
][162]

## Partners for medicine and research

We believe that tailored innovation and collaborative partnership are the keys to the best possible
healthcare for all. Therefore, we consistently place the needs of medical and research professionals
at the center of our work, just as much as the perspective of patients.

In our pursuit of optimal solutions, we are in close dialogue worldwide with our customers and are
genuinely interested in your needs. For we are convinced that successful partnership leads to mutual
and sustainable growth.

of pre-analysis, life science, laboratory automation and sample transport. The needs of the user are
always at the centre of our solutions.

[ICN Life-Science 1024x1024]

### Life Science

In the areas of liquid handling, cell culture, molecular biology, sample handling and microbiology,
we offer customised solutions of the highest purity and consistent quality. These are specially
designed to ensure reproducibility in analysis. Our products are certified and fulfil the strictest
requirements for research.

[
Life Science
][159]
[ICN Praaeanalytik 1024x1024]

### Preanalytics

For clinics, medical practices and laboratories, we offer a comprehensive range of sample collection
systems and accessories for blood, urine, faeces and saliva. We attach great importance to safety
and efficiency.

[
Preanalytics
][160]
[ICN Probentransport 1024x1024]

### Sample transport

As an essential part of the pre-analytical workflow, our sample transport products ensure the safety
and integrity of your diagnostic samples. We understand the need to safely ship potentially
infectious samples in accordance with clear ADR/RID and IATA dangerous goods regulations to ensure
the protection of all parties involved and to achieve optimal analytical results.

[
Sample transport
][161]
[ICN Labor-Automation 1024x1024]

### Laboratory automation

With our automation solutions, we make laboratory processes in pre-analytics faster, more precise
and more economical. Our many years of experience as a partner in laboratory automation make us a
reliable partner for your needs.

[
Laboratory automation

## The Inside Track - Biodesign

Mar 15, 2024

][94]

Welcome to "The Inside Track" podcast, a captivating series exploring the dynamic topics that span
the world of synthetic biology. Hosted by Jeff Buguliskis, the Director of Content for SynbioBeta,
this podcast invites listeners into thought-provoking conversations with leading innovators and
thinkers in the field. In each episode, Jeff and his special guests unravel the complexities and
marvels of Biodesign, providing insights into its application in various industries. From the
pioneering founder of Biodesign Challenge, Dan Grushkin, to the visionary architect and Co-Founder
of Biomason, Ginger Dosier, and the forward-thinking Director of Communications at LanzaTech, Kit
McDonnell, the podcast features a diverse range of perspectives. As they share their experiences and
expertise, listeners gain a deeper understanding of how biotechnology is shaping our future. "The
Inside Track" is more than a podcast—it's a journey into the heart of innovation, making complex
concepts in synthetic biology accessible and engaging for all. Join us on this exploratory
adventure, and stay tuned for more inspiring episodes.

[

Latest Podcast

## Mycelium Magic: Crafting a Greener Future - with Eben Bayer

Feb 16, 2024

][95]

On this SynBioBeta podcast, John Cumbers talks with Eben Bayer, the CEO of Ecovative, a pioneering
company at the forefront of developing sustainable materials using mycelium. John and Eben will
discuss Ecovative’s journey toward creating a billion pounds of mycelium, explore some of the
cutting-edge agricultural technology used in mushroom growing, and discuss the transformative
potential of new mycelium crops in consumer goods. Additionally, John and Eben will dive into
Ecovative’s unique use of AI and digital twins.

Eben Bayer is the CEO of Ecovative, a pioneering company at the forefront of developing sustainable
materials using mycelium, Co-founder of My Forest Foods, which uses mycelium to make foods like
Mybacon, and is listed as an inventor on 64+ patents. As an entrepreneur, inventor, and futurist,
Eben speaks around the world, communicating the immense potential of natural technologies and
advocating sustainable stewardship of Spaceship Earth. In addition to his executive roles at
Ecovative and MyForest Foods, he advises environmental start-ups in New York and worldwide. 

‍

Connect with Eben: [**@ebenbayer**][96]

Connect with John:[ **@johncumbers**][97]

## AI in Action: Synthesizing the Future of Drug Discovery - with Sean McClain

Dec 5, 2023

][98]

On this SynBioBeta podcast, John Cumbers talks with Sean McClain, founder, and CEO of Absci, a
generative AI drug creation company on a mission to create better drugs for patients faster. Sean
and John will continue some of the discussion that we started on the SynBioBeta stage around
generative AI and its critical role in drug discovery, some news from AbSci’s recent R&D day, and
Sean’s recent visit to Congress to discuss the opportunities and threats from AI and bio.

## The Inside Track - Biodesign

Mar 15, 2024

][94]

Welcome to "The Inside Track" podcast, a captivating series exploring the dynamic topics that span
the world of synthetic biology. Hosted by Jeff Buguliskis, the Director of Content for SynbioBeta,
this podcast invites listeners into thought-provoking conversations with leading innovators and
thinkers in the field. In each episode, Jeff and his special guests unravel the complexities and
marvels of Biodesign, providing insights into its application in various industries. From the
pioneering founder of Biodesign Challenge, Dan Grushkin, to the visionary architect and Co-Founder
of Biomason, Ginger Dosier, and the forward-thinking Director of Communications at LanzaTech, Kit
McDonnell, the podcast features a diverse range of perspectives. As they share their experiences and
expertise, listeners gain a deeper understanding of how biotechnology is shaping our future. "The
Inside Track" is more than a podcast—it's a journey into the heart of innovation, making complex
concepts in synthetic biology accessible and engaging for all. Join us on this exploratory
adventure, and stay tuned for more inspiring episodes.

[

Latest Podcast

## Mycelium Magic: Crafting a Greener Future - with Eben Bayer

Feb 16, 2024

][95]

On this SynBioBeta podcast, John Cumbers talks with Eben Bayer, the CEO of Ecovative, a pioneering
company at the forefront of developing sustainable materials using mycelium. John and Eben will
discuss Ecovative’s journey toward creating a billion pounds of mycelium, explore some of the
cutting-edge agricultural technology used in mushroom growing, and discuss the transformative
potential of new mycelium crops in consumer goods. Additionally, John and Eben will dive into
Ecovative’s unique use of AI and digital twins.

Eben Bayer is the CEO of Ecovative, a pioneering company at the forefront of developing sustainable
materials using mycelium, Co-founder of My Forest Foods, which uses mycelium to make foods like
Mybacon, and is listed as an inventor on 64+ patents. As an entrepreneur, inventor, and futurist,
Eben speaks around the world, communicating the immense potential of natural technologies and
advocating sustainable stewardship of Spaceship Earth. In addition to his executive roles at
Ecovative and MyForest Foods, he advises environmental start-ups in New York and worldwide. 

‍

## About us: Your vision is our mission

UGA Biopharma GmbH was established in 2009 in Hennigsdorf near Berlin, Germany. UGA Biopharma
specializes in the development of monoclonal cell lines for the production of advanced biologics and
biosimilars. Thanks to our technology platform and the expertise of our international team, we are
able to deliver top-quality processes rapidly and at low cost. Moreover, our portfolio includes
ready-to-use cell lines, which allow our customers to get started quickly in biosimilar development
for their own production.

Our own products – with the optimally matched CHO Prime^{®} cell culture medium and CHO Prime^{®}
feeds – offer a high-grade alternative to other commercially available media and feeds. They ensure
excellent productivity of our cell lines, as well as high quality of the products.

## About us: Your vision is our mission

UGA Biopharma GmbH was established in 2009 in Hennigsdorf near Berlin, Germany. UGA Biopharma
specializes in the development of monoclonal cell lines for the production of advanced biologics and
biosimilars. Thanks to our technology platform and the expertise of our international team, we are
able to deliver top-quality processes rapidly and at low cost. Moreover, our portfolio includes
ready-to-use cell lines, which allow our customers to get started quickly in biosimilar development
for their own production.

Our own products – with the optimally matched CHO Prime^{®} cell culture medium and CHO Prime^{®}
feeds – offer a high-grade alternative to other commercially available media and feeds. They ensure
excellent productivity of our cell lines, as well as high quality of the products.
